# Environment assets

Models in this folder are from "KayKit - Dungeon Remastered Pack" by Kay Lousberg
(https://kaylousberg.com / https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Dungeon-Remastered-1.0)
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain) - free for commercial use, no attribution required.
Attribution given anyway because the pack is great.

Also includes assets from these KayKit packs (all CC0 1.0, same author):
- KayKit - Halloween Bits (graveyard: arches, crypt, trees, fences, lanterns)
- KayKit - Medieval Hexagon Pack (castle, towers, ruins, mountains, nature)
- KayKit - Character Pack: Skeletons (animated skeleton characters)

vale.glb - "creek falls world maps" terrain, downloaded from Sketchfab by the site owner.
License: per the model page on Sketchfab (check author attribution requirements there).

wilds.glb - "Medieval Fantasy Book" by Pixel (https://sketchfab.com/Pixel_bear),
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/medieval-fantasy-book-06d5a80a04fc4c5ab552759e9a97d91a
License: CC Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Credit: "Medieval Fantasy Book" by Pixel, licensed under CC-BY.

estate.glb - "Mansion Map - Unlimited Gun For Hire" by Villanueva-Jonatan-32621 (https://sketchfab.com/vj32621),
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/7c903390ca3b41cfad98ea5bdf4f3c91
License: CC Attribution (CC-BY 4.0).
